Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Molecule_Dictionary, Compound_Structures. Join: Activities to Molecule_Dictionary via molregno. Molecule_Dictionary to Compound_Structures via molregno. Filter: assay_chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1217643'. standard_relation is not null. standard_relation equals '='. standard_value is not null. Sort: canonical_smiles ascending, molecule_chembl_id ascending, standard_type ascending, standard_relation ascending, standard_value ascending, standard_units ascending.
